## 1. Data integrity notes

The verified snapshot is the source of truth for every exact figure below.

- **Close discrepancy:** `get_stock_data` shows a 2026-11-19 close of 61,533.77. The verified snapshot shows 61,527.69, a gap of about 6 points. I use 61,527.69. The 11-19 bar may still be forming or revised, so treat the final close as provisional.
- **MACD discrepancy:** `get_indicators` returns -4,449.51 and the snapshot returns -4,449.99. The difference is immaterial. I use the snapshot value.
- **Indicators not pulled separately:** I did not request `macds`, `macdh`, `boll` or `boll_ub` as time series. Their latest values come from the snapshot only, so I make no claims about their recent history.
- **Matching values:** The 10 EMA, 50 SMA, 200 SMA, RSI, lower Bollinger band and ATR agree between the snapshot and `get_indicators`.

## 2. Indicators selected and why

I chose 8 indicators that avoid redundancy and cover different questions:

| Role | Indicator | Question it answers |
|---|---|---|
| Long-term trend | `close_200_sma` | Is the structural trend intact? |
| Medium-term trend | `close_50_sma` | Is the intermediate trend rolling over? |
| Short-term trend | `close_10_ema` | Is there any near-term momentum shift? |
| Momentum/trend | `macd` (with `macds` and `macdh` from the snapshot) | Is downside momentum accelerating or fading? |
| Overbought/oversold | `rsi` | How stretched is the move? |
| Volatility envelope | `boll_lb` (with `boll` and `boll_ub` from the snapshot) | Where is price relative to its statistical range? |
| Volatility/risk | `atr` | How wide should stops and sizes be? |
| Volume-weighted trend | `vwma` | Does volume-weighted value agree with the price trend? |

## 3. Price action

**Latest verified bar (2026-11-19):**
- Open 62,987.29, High 63,985.29, Low 61,456.85, Close 61,527.69
- Volume 33.27B

**The Aug–Oct rally has been fully retraced.**
- From 2026-07-03 to 2026-08-18, closes mostly held between about 62.2k and 66.5k.
- The range broke higher on 2026-08-19 (close 69,266.19). The next two sessions closed at 73,032.76 and 78,335.19.
- The highest close in the window was 86,602.91 on 2026-09-21. The highest high was 87,363.76 on the same day.
- Price stayed mostly in the low-to-mid 80ks through October. The last close above 84k was 84,011.97 on 2026-10-21.
- The slide started with a drop on 2026-10-29 (close 81,267.59 to 77,775.11). A spike to 80,405.29 on 2026-11-04 was fully reversed the next day (close 75,942.12).
- The slide then accelerated:

| Date | Close |

| 2026-11-12 | 71,342.97 |
| 2026-11-13 | 68,249.27 |
| 2026-11-14 | 64,128.05 |
| 2026-11-19 | 61,527.69 |

- Price is now below the base from which the August breakout launched (2026-08-18 close 64,680.71).
- It is also below the floor of the July–August range (closes near 62.2k–62.8k).
- From the 2026-10-21 close of 84,011.97 to 61,527.69 is a decline of about 26.8%.

**Recent lows and short-term structure:**
- The 2026-11-15 low was 62,017.88 and the 2026-11-18 low was 62,017.38. The 2026-11-19 low of 61,456.85 broke below both.
- The bounce after the 11-14 flush was weak. Closes were 65,305.06, 64,855.84 and 64,893.95, then price rolled over again.

- 2026-06-05: low 59,108.92

## 4. Trend indicators

|---|---:|---|
| 10 EMA | 66,622.05 | Price below |
| VWMA | 68,574.43 (from `get_indicators`; not in snapshot) | Price below |

- **10 EMA:** It has fallen every day in the lookback, from 82,645.11 on 2026-10-21 to 66,622.05. Price is about 5.1k below it, so there is no short-term bullish shift yet. A reclaim of this level would be the first sign of stabilization.

- **50/200 relationship:** The 50 SMA is still above the 200 SMA, a "golden cross" configuration. The gap has narrowed from roughly 8.8k on 2026-11-04 to about 5.5k now. A naive linear extrapolation of that pace would put convergence a few weeks out, which is illustrative only. If price stays below both, a death cross is a plausible later development.
- **VWMA:** It has fallen steadily from about 82.3k on 2026-10-20 to 68,574.43. Volume-weighted average cost has therefore dropped alongside price.

## 5. Momentum: MACD and RSI

**MACD (snapshot values):**
- MACD line: -4,449.99
- Signal: -3,425.14

- The MACD line crossed below zero between 2026-10-22 (+44.28) and 2026-10-23 (-69.35).
- It has deepened almost every day since. It was -2,529.17 on 11-13 and -3,150.63 on 11-14, against -4,449.51 on `get_indicators` for 11-19.
- A negative and widening histogram means downside momentum has not yet decelerated.
- There is no bullish crossover and no sign of the histogram shrinking.

**RSI:**
- RSI is 20.19, deeply oversold by the standard 30 threshold.
- It has been below 30 since 2026-11-13 (24.99), with 29.96 on 11-12.
- On 2026-11-14 it was 20.186, and now it is 20.186. That is the same RSI at a lower price, so there is no bullish divergence. A lower price low with a higher RSI low would be the textbook divergence setup.
- RSI was 50.65 on 2026-11-04 and 56.68 on 2026-10-21, so the fall into oversold took about four weeks.
- In strong downtrends RSI can stay oversold for extended periods. Oversold alone is not a buy signal.

## 6. Volatility and Bollinger Bands

Snapshot values:
- Middle band: 71,916.50
- Upper band: 83,799.88
- Lower band: 60,033.12

- Price (61,527.69) is about 1,494 above the lower band, roughly 0.58 ATR. The 11-19 low (61,456.85) did not touch it.
- Price is about 14.4% below the middle band.
- The bands are wide, about 23.8k from lower to upper. That reflects the volatility of the whole Aug–Nov swing.
- The lower band has been falling every day, from about 80.0k on 2026-10-20 to 60,033.12.
- Price closed below the lower band on 2026-11-14 (close 64,128.05 vs. band 67,403.03) and on 2026-11-15 (65,305.06 vs. 65,702.40). It then moved back above the band and stayed there while the band continued to fall.
- That is a band-walk pattern with a falling lower band. A touch or break of the lower band here is not automatically a reversal. In a trending decline, price can ride the band.

**ATR:**
- ATR is 2,590.20, about 4.2% of price. It was 1,938.92 on 2026-11-03, a rise of about a third in 16 days.
- Volatility is expanding with the decline, which is typical of a sell-off in progress.
- Illustrative stop widths: 1.5× ATR is about 3,885 and 2× ATR is about 5,180.
- Position sizes should be scaled for this elevated volatility.

## 7. Volume context

- Volume was elevated through the sell-off: 42.99B on 2026-11-13, 44.02B on 11-14 and 39.76B on 11-15.
- Volume on 11-18 was 30.35B and on 11-19 it was 33.27B. This was less than the 11-13 and 11-14 peak, even as price made new lows.
- I do not read this as proof of exhaustion. The 11-19 volume figure may be incomplete if the bar is still forming.

## 8. Synthesis

**Bias:** Bearish on trend and momentum, with stretched oversold conditions. There is no confirmed reversal signal in the data.

**Bearish evidence:**
- Price is below the 10 EMA, VWMA, 200 SMA and 50 SMA.
- The 10 EMA and 50 SMA are falling.
- MACD is below zero, below its signal, and the histogram is widening negative.
- Price has broken below the multi-month 62–66k range and below the August breakout base.
- The 11-19 low is a new low relative to the prior two sessions.
- ATR is expanding.

**Potential stabilization evidence (not yet present):**
- RSI at 20.19 is extreme.
- Price sits near the lower Bollinger band.
- Prior June–July lows at 57.7k–60k are the nearest reference zone in this data.

**Conditional scenarios:**
- **Relief bounce:** Oversold readings can produce sharp counter-trend moves. The first overhead references are the 62.0k broken lows, then the 64.1k–64.9k area (11-14 close and the 11-16/11-17 closes). Next come the 10 EMA (~66.6k), the VWMA (~68.6k) and the 200 SMA (~72.6k). A rally to the 10 EMA that fails there would still be consistent with a downtrend.
- **Continuation lower:** A close below the lower band (60,033.12) would extend the band-walk pattern. The next reference is the 57.7k–60k prior-low zone, including 2026-07-01's 57,747.77.
- **Reversal signs to watch:** These are not present today.
  - RSI makes a higher low while price makes a lower low.
  - The MACD histogram stops widening and turns up.
  - Price closes back above the 10 EMA.
  - Volume expands on up days.

**Risk management:**
- Use ATR-scaled stops of at least 1.5–2× ATR (about 3.9k–5.2k) given the volatility.
- Avoid treating RSI below 30 or the lower band as a standalone entry.
- Confirm any long idea with a momentum turn and a reclaim of the short-term average.
- Short-side ideas should respect the risk of a violent oversold bounce.

This keeps the aggressive analyst's thesis and entry zone, and the conservative analyst's concern about squeeze exposure and discretionary exits.
